## Change summary

- **Problem / user or operator outcome:**
- **Implementation summary:**
- **Affected services and owners:**

## Contract and data impact

- [ ] Public HTTP / GraphQL / Socket.IO contract reviewed
- [ ] Internal API / AMQP event contract reviewed
- [ ] Database/schema/migration impact reviewed
- [ ] Cross-service consumers and compatibility checked
- [ ] Ownership / tenant / shared-data access rules tested

## Security, privacy and reliability

- [ ] Authentication and authorization behavior reviewed
- [ ] Input bounds, timeouts, retries and idempotency reviewed
- [ ] Secrets and sensitive values excluded from code, logs and docs
- [ ] Data retention/deletion and object lifecycle considered
- [ ] Metrics, logs, health and failure modes considered

## Verification evidence

| Command / scenario | Environment | Result / artifact |
|---|---|---|
| | | |

- [ ] Focused tests passed
- [ ] Relevant downstream/consumer tests passed
- [ ] Lint, typecheck and build passed where applicable
- [ ] Manual, browser or physical-device validation performed where needed
- [ ] `git diff --check` passed

## Release and documentation

- [ ] Migration and deployment order documented
- [ ] Rollback / forward recovery documented
- [ ] Runbooks, API docs and architecture docs updated
- [ ] Known limitations and rollout risks listed

## Evidence boundary

State what the checks prove and what remains unverified. Do not imply production operation, compliance certification, a measured SLO or capacity result without a retained artifact.
